title: Mozzarella, Asparagus & Strawberry Salad with Poppy Seed Dressing

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until asparagus is tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, poppy seeds, Dijon, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and slice strawberries crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Add roasted asparagus and mixed greens to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with mozzarella. Enjoy!
